feeds.title: ChoralNet Blog
feeds.description: ChoralNet is a professional networking site for the global online choral community. Here are forums, choral organizations, choirs, resources, and the latest news of interest to the choral world.

feeds.title: Chris Rowbury Blog
feeds.description: Chris Rowbury's blog about singing and choirs, songs and natural voice, traditional songs from many cultures, and unaccompanied harmony singing. Chris has 30 years' experience of teaching and running workshops in singing, voice and theatre. He has worked all over the world as a teacher, director and performer. He has taught at the Royal Festival Hall in London, at several well-known UK drama schools, at music festivals and for major corporations.

feeds.title: Tenebrae Choir
feeds.description: Award-winning choir Tenebrae, under the direction of Nigel Short, is one of the world's finest vocal ensembles renowned for its passion and precision. Follow this blog to know more about them.

feeds.title: Chorus Connection Blog
feeds.description: The Chorus Connection blog offers educational and inspirational choral resources for community choir directors, choir managers, board members, arts patrons, and singers in the choir.

feeds.title: Pink Singers Blog
feeds.description: We're the Pink Singers, a fun, friendly LGBT+ (lesbian, gay, bisexual, and trans) choir based in London. We've been singing since 1983, making us the longest-running LGBT+ choir in Europe!

feeds.title: ChoirCommunity Blog
feeds.description: In this blog, you will find Carefully Crafted Choral Compositions and Arrangements, created by experienced composers and choir leaders.

feeds.title: Choral Clarity Blog
feeds.description: The Choral Clarity blog written by Adam Paltrowitz offers inspiration, direction, and clarity to all choral directors. Let us guide you.

feeds.title: Risca Male Choir
feeds.description: Risca Male Choir / Risca Choir was founded in 1970. Risca Male Choir regularly write blogs. Read about their concerts, practices, tours, and more. A friendly local choir in South Wales.

feeds.title: Cape Town Youth Choir
feeds.description: Founded in 1997 under the name Pro Cantu, the Cape Town Youth Choir aims to provide an opportunity for young South Africans to sing in a choir of the highest international standards while delivering a moving musical experience to its audiences.

feeds.title: South Devon Choir Blog
feeds.description: South Devon Choir welcomes singers of all ages and abilities to learn and perform some of the world's greatest choral works and some lighter pieces too.

feeds.title: Esk Community Choir
feeds.description: Established in 1978, Esk Community Choir has lived the motto 'Service in Song' through its performances, both locally and internationally. Follow this blog, to know more about them.

feeds.title: Sydney Chamber Choir Blog
feeds.description: Sydney Chamber Choir has forged a reputation as one of Australia's leading choral ensembles. Find out what's new with Sydney Chamber Choir, here.

feeds.title: Choir Genius Blog
feeds.description: The Choir Genius blog provides practical advice, tips, and resources for choir and chorus management, focusing on strategies for recruitment, rehearsal techniques, technology integration, and leadership in the choral community.

feeds.title: Chorus America
feeds.description: The High Notes blog by Chorus America features the latest news, commentary, and updates on issues relevant to the choral community, including policy matters, advocacy alerts, and organizational updates.

feeds.title: SFGMC Blog
feeds.description: The SFGMC blog shares updates, stories, and reflections from the San Francisco Gay Men's Chorus, focusing on their performances, community engagement, and advocacy for LGBTQ+ rights and visibility through music.

feeds.title: The Rivertones Chorus Blog
feeds.description: We are an all-male accapella harmony chorus based in Taunton, Somerset. Our aim is to encourage the enjoyment of Barbershop style singing

feeds.title: The Choir Girl
feeds.description: I'm a choir girl who is passionate about all things choir, music, and performance-related. I detail my musical musings and experiences here on this blog.

feeds.title: Easy Choir Music Blog
feeds.description: Looking for encouragement as you work to improve your choir? Check out the ECM blog for tips, resources, and advice on how to make your ensemble the best it can be.

feeds.title: Milwaukee Children's Choir Blog
feeds.description: Milwaukee Children's Choir provides exceptional choral music education and performance experiences that foster creativity, personal expression, and social growth. Get their latest updates here.

feeds.title: The Choir Director Corner Blog
feeds.description: The Choir Director Corner provides choir director resources and positive encouragement. This is where you'll find posts about the world of choral music and about being high.

feeds.title: Lichfield Gospel Choir Blog
feeds.description: A lively, joyful gospel choir with over 100 members and a repertoire that embraces African, gospel & soulful music.

feeds.title: Pacific Pride Choir Blog
feeds.description: Founded by Sarah & Melanie Penicka-Smith, with the help of KIconcerts, Pacific Pride Choir (PPC) is an occasional touring choir created to contribute to the visibility & acceptance of LGBTQI+ people in countries where homosexuality is legalised, but not fully recognised.

feeds.title: The Bach Choir of Bethlehem Blog
feeds.description: The Bach Choir of Bethlehem is the oldest American Bach Choir, and gave the first American performances of Bach's Mass in B Minor and Christmas Oratorio.

feeds.title: Houston Horizon Chorus Blog
feeds.description: HHC is a chapter of Sweet Adelines International, a global women's organization focusing on education and sisterhood through the art of barbershop music.

feeds.title: Tabernacle Choir Home
feeds.description: The Tabernacle Choir is dedicated to the universal language of music that has the power to bring joy, peace, and healing to its listeners. Made up of hundreds of volunteers from all walks of life, this unique music organization transcends cultural and generational boundaries and brings together people from around the world through stirring music.

feeds.title: Cantala choir Blog
feeds.description: A helpful set of informative blogs about singing, sight reading, choral manners, and rehearsal tips that improve your choral music singing experience.

feeds.title: Total Choir Resources
feeds.description: Total Choir Resources is the online home for choir leaders. We help people all over the world to start, grow, and inspire successful happy choirs.

feeds.title: Choirscript Blog
feeds.description: Choirscript offer a wide range of music sheets in sol-fa notations including popular concert videos and scripts as well as classical and liturgical sheets for choirs, choirmasters and choristers. Get the clearest and free tonic Solfa notation music sheet/scripts for liturgical celebrations suitable for any event, competition, rendition, etc

feeds.title: Bristol Show Choir
feeds.description: Bristol Show Choir is Bristol's Number 1 Musical Theatre Choir! Founded by professional singers & seasoned conductors, Doug Watts & Jessica Broderick, Show Choir burst onto the scene in February 2017 & has gone from strength to strength, with popular groups across the city.

feeds.title: Everyday Singing
feeds.description: Blog curated by vocal leader & author James Sills, updated weekly. Because life is better when we're singing together. Everyday Singing is based on the principle of Everyday Creativity, the principle that everyone is creative and it is something we can make part of our everyday lives.
